stemMd: How many electrons can occupy one orbital in an atom?
explanationMd: The Pauli exclusion principle permits at most two electrons in an orbital, with opposite spins. Distinguish an individual orbital from a subshell containing several orbitals.

distractorRationale.a: An orbital can accommodate opposite-spin electrons.
distractorRationale.d: This is a common valence-shell count, not orbital capacity.
distractorRationale.c: This is the capacity of an entire p subshell.
distractorRationale.e: This is the capacity of an entire d subshell.
